description: List directory contents at a ref. `path` scopes the listing to a subtree and is honoured in BOTH modes; `recursive: true` walks the whole subtree instead of one level. Always returns the same shape: {path, ref, recursive, entries, truncated, totalCount}. Recursive entries carry full repo-relative paths; non-recursive entries carry names. A ref that does not exist is an error, never an empty listing.

ref.description: Branch / tag / sha. Omit (or pass HEAD) for the default branch.

name: gluecron_list_tree
